pages.text: Hold one thing in each hand and press $(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact).$(br2)Most pairings mean nothing. Some mean everything. You will not know which until you try, and sometimes not even then.
Holding $(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact) down with a bare stick is its own kind of work. Your teeth were tools long before anything else was.
What teeth can start, a sharp edge can finish better.
